FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 228
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Senator Andrew Jones
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/01/2025
Senate Bill 228as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama State
Banking Department (SBD) and the Alabama Department of Insurance (DOI) to receive and
investigate complaints of discrimination by certain financial institutions and insurers. Any
increased obligations would be offset partly by: (1) the filing fee (up to $50), required to be
collected by the SBD and/or the DOI for each claim filed and found not to be substantiated by
the claimant; (2) any civil penalties imposed by the Superintendent of Banking on financial
institutions violating the provisions of this bill; and (3) any administrative fines imposed by the
Commissioner of Insurance on insurers violating the provisions of this bill.
This bill could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from
fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of insurers charged with and convicted of the unfair trade practices pursuant to
the provisions of this bill and the penalties imposed.
